title: Disconfirm the static AmbiConverter channel operators and process-state model
status: prospective; no target execution authorized or performed in this phase
purpose: Test predictions from the retained instructions against independently captured target outputs. A static derivation and its synthetic transcription tests are not reference observations.
prerequisites: Identify the complete bundle, architecture, legitimate activation state and actually loaded executable/dependencies. Pin the processing precision, sample rate, block size, bus arrangements and floating-point control state.
Separate direct plug-in process calls in a controlled host from Cubase project exports. Direct calls can test buffer-index semantics; they cannot establish Cubase routing or product equivalence.
Qualify the capture instrument with a separately authored transparent processor and deliberate channel swaps, gain changes, one-sample offsets and output-sentinel preservation controls.

Keep each input and output plane, parameter queue including point offsets, input/output silence flags, pointer relationship, process return status and pre-call output contents. Preserve exact sample bits before any file export or layout conversion.

Repeat each initial condition three times, including fresh instance creation and a restart. Interpret agreement as observed repeatability only. Do not replace failed captures or select a favourable repeat.

primary_predictions.configuration: N = 4, 9, 16; both float32 and float64; disjoint planes; positive frame count; bypass false; silence flags zero; explicit direction p = 0 or 1
primary_predictions.stimulus: One input plane at a time contains exactly +1/8 at a known sample index; all other samples are +0. Use every plane and repeat with -1/8. Retain all output planes.
primary_predictions.prediction: The retained source-to-destination permutation selects the sole nonzero output plane, then its destination-indexed stored gain is applied in sample precision.
primary_predictions.disconfirmation: A nonzero sample in another plane, an unexpected sample position or a different coefficient disconfirms the bounded prediction. First assess capture/routing controls; do not infer a product defect from disagreement.

primary_predictions.stimulus: Use distinct signed dyadic values on every plane. Supply p immediately below 0.5, exactly 0.5 and immediately above 0.5 as binary64 values. Then supply two direction points at increasing sample offsets and swap the values assigned to those offsets in a separate case. Keep index/time order valid; reversed time order is a separate exploratory malformed-input question until interface legality is established.
primary_predictions.prediction: The traced consumer uses the final retrieved point for parameter ID 2 before processing the block. The static branch chooses A below 0.5 and B at or above 0.5 for finite values in [0,1].
primary_predictions.disconfirmation: A within-block switch or a different queue/boundary selection contradicts this prediction under the recorded lifecycle and queue conditions.

primary_predictions.configuration: Direct raw-buffer chaining; N = 9 first; fresh and fully configured instances A then B; no host permutation, normalization or intermediate conversion
primary_predictions.stimulus: Probe input plane 4 and input plane 8 separately, with exactly 1/8 and all other planes zero. Record the intermediate and final buffers.
primary_predictions.prediction: The traced permutations compose to the original plane, but destination-indexed gains predict a non-unit coefficient product for these two planes. Plane 4 has coefficient product 0.8660254037844386; plane 8 has 1.1547005383792517 before per-stage sample rounding. Use the retained bit patterns to compute rounded predictions, not these display decimals.
alternatives: The static call-path or table interpretation is wrong.
A lifecycle or parameter condition selects a different path.
The measured host inserts a channel permutation or another transform.
primary_predictions.interpretation: A non-identity result is a prospective prediction for this exact raw-buffer composition, not an established audible result or a Cubase defect. Measure single-stage operators before interpreting the composition.

secondary_state_matrix.status: Prospective predictions fixed from independently reviewed AMBI-STATE-004; no reference calls or captures performed.
variables: Zero, one and multiple frames, with parameter updates on zero-frame calls
Bypass false/true and transitions, using distinct nonzero pre-call output sentinels

Each input silence bit separately, all silence bits and zero flags; every flagged input plane must actually contain only zero samples and retain valid storage. Nonzero output sentinels remain permitted. Record both output data and flags.
Disjoint buffers versus corresponding in-place buffers; retain pointer relationships
Direction queue absent after explicit A or B, plus fresh construction and state restoration as separate histories
secondary_state_matrix.cross_alias_policy: Do not treat arbitrary cross-channel overlaps as valid until the host interface contract and target preconditions have been established. Static branch inspection alone does not establish caller legality.
secondary_state_matrix.preconditions: Use valid stable algorithm, precision, tables, scratch capacity and bus storage under the complete finding valid_domain. Do not generalize the unusual initial precision/pointer guard into a complete validation check.

predictions.sequence: After valid setup, submit direction ID2 and bypass ID1 updates on a zero-frame call, then process positive frames without resending those queues. Keep the instrument able to distinguish parameter consumption from audio processing.
predictions.prediction: The traced parameter consumer runs before the zero-frame early return, so successful updates can affect the subsequent block. The zero-frame path issues no audio/meter dispatch or process-body output silenceFlags store.

predictions.sequence: Use bypass ID1 immediately below, exactly at, and immediately above 0.5, separately from direction ID2. Supply both zero and valid nonzero input silence masks.
predictions.prediction: For finite normalized values the bypass byte is set iff p>0.5. A nonzero byte chooses same-index copy before the silence test; this differs from direction ID2, whose high branch includes 0.5. Corresponding identical pointers skip their copy.

predictions.sequence: For each channel in turn, zero that entire input plane and set exactly its silence bit; keep other planes nonzero and output planes prefilled with distinct finite sentinels. Compare bypass off and on.
predictions.prediction: With bypass off the traced branch issues neither normal conversion nor bypass copy for any nonzero mask, then stores the mask unchanged. Input/output meter paths and frame accounting may still run. With bypass on, the copy path is selected.
predictions.qualification: Retain full before/after output and flags. Do not infer zero samples from a silence flag or claim that all memory is untouched. Attribute untouched sample bytes only after the capture instrument and called meter-function contracts are qualified; meter emission remains outside this static contract.

predictions.sequence: Compare disjoint planes against distinct-channel configurations in which one or more output pointers exactly equal their same-index input pointers and all remaining regions are disjoint. Preserve valid scratch capacity.
predictions.prediction: The normal conversion equality scan selects staging of all input channels when it finds any same-index equality. Bypass instead skips each same-index self-copy. Cross-channel/partial overlaps remain excluded.

comparison_and_acceptance.primary: Exact output sample bits, positions, buffer order and side effects under the named condition; no alignment, gain fitting, channel relabeling or hidden tolerance.
comparison_and_acceptance.numerical_diagnostics: Retain absolute and ULP differences alongside the exact result. A discrepancy may justify a separately preregistered model of library rounding or FP state; it does not retroactively turn an exact comparison into a pass.
separate_acceptance_levels: Reference repeatability for the named conditions
Independent candidate conformance on reserved conditions
Integration within an identified Cubase configuration
comparison_and_acceptance.held_out_cases: After fixing the prediction and candidate, use separately generated multi-plane dyadic sequences, non-power-of-two block lengths and compound state histories. Retain the generation seed and all failures with the evidence.
comparison_and_acceptance.not_established_by_this_experiment: Full plug-in behavior, all exceptional floating-point inputs, all lifecycle states, all platforms, other bundled processors or whole-product Cubase fidelity.

review_notes: Independent review confirmed the plane4/8 coefficient predictions and required valid zero-filled planes for silence flags and increasing offsets in primary queue tests. The broader state predictions remain pending.
Revision2 adds state predictions from independent AMBI-STATE-004 review. Native host execution and runtime conformance remain pending; revision1 is preserved with its digest.
